description: Return how much a type of power tool vibrates and how loud makers declare it, such as an angle grinder, SDS drill or breaker: the median and spread of declared figures across models, the matching HSE vibration category and variants, and HSE in-use noise comparisons where available. Omit type to list the types. It does not return maker-model rows or quotes; declared LpA is not measured task LAeq.

type.description: Tool-type slug returned by this tool, for example angle-grinder; omit to list all available types.

name: power_tool_types

summary.description: The answer, figure or code first.
